findings.description: Changing the sort order does nothing. The list stays in Name (A to Z) order for Z to A, price low to high and price high to low.
repro: Sign in as customer
On /inventory.html choose each of Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), Price (high to low)
The product order never changes

findings.description: Remove on the product list does nothing. The button stays Remove and the cart badge does not drop, so a product can only be removed from the cart page.
repro: Sign in as customer
Click Add to basket on two products (badge 2)
Click Remove on one of them
Button stays Remove and badge stays 2

findings.description: Remove on the product detail page does nothing. After Add to basket the button turns to Remove, but clicking it leaves the item in the cart and the badge unchanged.
repro: Sign in as customer
Open /inventory-item.html?id=4
Click Add to basket (badge increments)
Click Remove; the button and badge do not change

findings.description: The product detail page shows no description, although the list shows one. The console logs 'This component failed to render!'.
repro: Sign in as customer
Open /inventory-item.html?id=4 or click a product name
Name, price and photo show but the description is missing

findings.description: Last Name is not validated. With First Name and Zip filled and Last Name empty, Continue goes to the overview. With only First Name filled the error says 'Postal Code is required' and never mentions Last Name.
repro: Sign in, add a product, open the cart, Checkout
Fill First Name and Zip, leave Last Name empty, Continue
The overview opens without an error
Alternatively fill only First Name and Continue: the error is 'Postal Code is required'

findings.description: Finish does not complete the order. The page stays on the overview, the cart keeps its items, and the console logs a page error 'Ra.cesetRart is not a function'. Checkout cannot be completed through the UI.
repro: Sign in, add two products, open the cart, Checkout
Fill in the details and Continue
On the overview click Finish
Nothing happens; the URL stays /checkout-step-two.html and the badge still shows the items

notes: Sign-in, logout, auth redirects, tax and totals (8%), cart page Remove and Continue Shopping checked and fine. Copy says 'basket' where the brief says 'cart'; treated as deliberate and not reported.

cost.notes: estimate from 45381 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0091-$0.1089
